(2) A young child sits on a tan sofa in a living room, holding a purple bag of snacks and eating a triangular chip. The child is wearing a white and blue striped long-sleeve shirt. (3) Two other children, one with glasses in a pink shirt and one in a grey hoodie, are shown sitting on the same sofa, also holding purple chip bags and eating. (4) The woman is now in a brightly lit living room with a large black-and-white Mickey Mouse graphic on the wall. She smiles and gestures broadly towards the camera while presenting the large Cadina corn and rice chip box. (5) A close-up shot of the purple and yellow Cadina corn and rice chip box displays the product imagery and branding clearly, with no people in the frame. (6) The woman and two children sit on the wooden floor, enthusiastically opening a new shipping box. They use their hands to pull at the cardboard flaps. (7) A man wearing a blue LA Dodgers baseball cap is seen inside a car interior at night. He uses his right hand to eat a chip from a purple bag. (8) The woman stands in a modern kitchen with marble countertops and a stainless steel refrigerator. She holds two individual bags of chips and speaks energetically to the camera. (9) A close-up view of the back of the chip bag highlights nutritional information and specific labels like 'non-fried' and 'no MSG' in colored circles. (10) Multiple short clips show the children and the woman eating the chips in various locations, including at an office desk with a laptop and finally in an outdoor park setting with green bushes and natural daylight.
